title: Sectionwise square-zero unit-additive kernel comparison
statement: Let g: X → Y be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Assume that on every etale Y-object V, any two sections of the structure ring restricting to zero on V ×_Y X have zero product. Then the kernel of unit restriction [def-sc-gm-torsor] is isomorphic to the kernel of additive restriction [def-sc-etale-additive-structure-restriction], as abelian sheaves on Y with the same coefficient universe lift. No ideal sheaves or closed immersion are assumed.

source.place: Proof, Step 1 and its Claim; affine argument preserved in lem-sc-reduction-units-power-cokernel; extracted from the image comparison proof as SquareZeroRelativeUnitsAdditiveKernel

proof.text: For a unit-kernel section u, ring restriction sends u-1 to zero. The square-zero section hypothesis applied to u-1 and v-1 implies uv-1=(u-1)+(v-1). Thus u ↦ u-1 is an additive map from the unit kernel to the additive structure sheaf. Ring-map naturality gives a sheaf morphism, and its composite with additive restriction is zero, so the categorical kernel universal property factors it into the additive kernel.

For an additive-kernel section a, construct the unit with value 1+a and inverse 1-a; both inverse identities follow from a*a=0. The equality a*b=0 gives (1+a)(1+b)=1+a+b, hence an additive map into the units written additively. Ring restriction commutes with this formula, and its image restricts to 1, so it factors through the unit kernel. The two composites are identities after the monic kernel inclusions, by (1+a)-1=a and 1+(u-1)=u. All formulas include the coefficient ULift and hold over the zero ring.

theorem nonempty_unitsAdditiveKernelIso_of_sections {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    (hsq : ∀ (V : Y.Etaleᵒᵖ) (a b : Y.etaleStructurePresheaf.obj V),
      (etaleStructurePresheafToPullback g).app V a = 0 →
      (etaleStructurePresheafToPullback g).app V b = 0 → a * b = 0) :
    Nonempty (kernel (gmSheafToLowerStarGmSheaf g) ≅
      kernel (etaleAdditiveSheafToLowerStar g))
